nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-053 Block 5 — Execute Agent Session (v1), the managed-agents Stage B core. CONTRACT inputs (first call from Stage A/orchestrator): user_message (person prefs + task context + triggering comment), impact, input_images_json (Read Input's image blocks, fed to Upload Input Images), clickup_task_id, caller_user_id, process_type, triggered_by (a valid agent_runs enum, e.g. explicit_mention), invocation_type. CARRIED-STATE inputs (empty on first call, set by the Recurse self-call per generate_image tool round): session_id, anthropic_key, file_map_json, deadline_epoch, tool_round, images_json, warnings_json, agent_id, model_id. Same When Called serves both initial and recursive entry (research-the-web idiom); Is Recursive? branches on session_id.

nodes.name: Is Recursive?
nodes.notes: session_id non-empty => this is a recursive tool-servicing round (TRUE, main[0]) -> carry state straight to Merge State. Empty => first call (FALSE, main[1]) -> run setup (key, agent, upload images, create session, send message). Mirrors research-the-web's depth-gated re-entry.

nodes.name: Get Anthropic Key
nodes.notes: Reads the anthropic_api_key Vault secret via SECURITY DEFINER getter public.get_anthropic_key() (migration 034). Code nodes can't use n8n credentials and $env/$vars are unavailable on this CE (CLAUDE.md). Returns {key} (null if unseeded -> Create Session 401 -> CRITICAL on the error branch). Hard DB failure throws -> errorWorkflow CRITICAL.

nodes.name: Resolve Agent
nodes.notes: impact -> tier agent (agent_routing, ADR-053 Block 2) with __default__ fallback, plus the persistent environment id from config.managed_agent_environment_id (Block 5 one-time setup). Returns {agent_id, model_id, environment_id}. onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so a transient miss still flows; a missing agent_id/env -> Create Session 4xx -> CRITICAL error branch.

parameters.query:
select r.agent_id, r.model_id,
       (select value from public.config where key = 'managed_agent_environment_id') as environment_id
from public.agent_routing r
where r.impact in ($1, '__default__') and r.active = true
order by (r.impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Call Upload Input Images
nodes.notes: ADR-053 Block 3: fetch + upload Read Input's image blocks to the Files API. Returns {file_map:[{file_id,url,source_ref,mime,alt,order}], warnings[]}. onError=continueRegularOutput so an upload failure (its own WARNs are RETURNED) never blocks the session — the task proceeds text-only. Build Setup folds file_map into the user.message image blocks and carries warnings forward.

nodes.name: Build Setup
nodes.notes: Compose the session create body + user.message. Input images (sorted by order) become {type:image, source:{type:file, file_id}} blocks; user_message text last (image-then-text, mirrors the Block-3 vision probe). Carries Upload Input Images' warnings into warnings_json. Emits key/agent_id/environment_id/file_map_json/message_body_json + passthrough metadata.

nodes.name: Create Session
nodes.notes: POST /v1/sessions {agent, environment_id} (Block 0 shape). Both betas. onError=continueErrorOutput: a 4xx/5xx (missing/invalid key, missing agent_id, missing env) routes to Build Create Failed -> CRITICAL + a failed output (the whole lane is unusable for this task, not a silent degrade).

nodes.name: Send User Message
nodes.notes: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/events with the user.message built by Build Setup (text + input-image file_id blocks). Both betas (required when a user.message references a file_id, Block 0/3). onError=continueErrorOutput -> Build Send Failed -> CRITICAL + failed output. NB Block 0: a corrupt input image is accepted at send=200 and only fails later as session.error 'Could not process image' — Poll Round reads events to idle and surfaces that as outcome=terminated, so send=200 is not trusted as success of the image.

nodes.name: Build Initial State
nodes.notes: Seed the carried loop state after the first message is sent: session_id (from Create Session), the absolute soft-deadline (now + 840s, mirrors the image batch's 840s<900s), tool_round 0, empty images, Upload Input Images' warnings, agent/model + passthrough metadata. Feeds Merge State (input 0).

nodes.name: Build Create Failed
nodes.notes: Create Session error branch: build a status:failed output + a CRITICAL warning. failure_kind='create' -> Classify Alert fires CRITICAL. Feeds Merge Final (input 1), so the single terminal still returns a well-formed failure.

nodes.name: Build Send Failed
nodes.notes: Send User Message error branch: status:failed + CRITICAL warning. failure_kind='send'. Carries the created session_id (the session exists; the first message POST failed). Feeds Merge Final (input 2).

nodes.name: Merge State
nodes.notes: Converge the first-call seed (Build Initial State, input 0) and the recursive carry (Is Recursive? TRUE, input 1) into ONE stream so Poll Round keeps a SINGLE input. Append; exactly one branch executes per call.

nodes.name: Poll Round
nodes.notes: The wait. Polls GET /events (full history) + GET /session status to the next pause/settle/deadline, entirely inside this Code node via this.helpers.httpRequest + setTimeout (no n8n Wait-loop, no poll-tick recursion). Absolute 840s soft-deadline carried as deadline_epoch (840s<900s task-runner kill, mirrors the image batch). STATELESS pending detection: a custom_tool_use is answered iff a user.custom_tool_result with its id exists in history (Block 0: our posts land in the log) -> no answered-set to carry. DONE = status idle AND an agent.message exists AFTER the last user event (handles the transient pre-run idle and the post-tool-result idle). Outcomes: pending_tool (idle + unanswered custom tool, round<12) | max_rounds (>=12) | done | terminated (session.error or status terminated) | deadline | poll_error (>=5 consecutive GET errors). Returns the carried state + outcome + the pending tool + final text + raw usage/duration/web_search_count for Block 6.

nodes.name: Has Pending Tool?
nodes.notes: TRUE (main[0]): outcome=pending_tool -> service the custom tool, then recurse. FALSE (main[1]): done/terminated/deadline/max_rounds/poll_error -> Build Final Output (the terminal path). Mutually exclusive leaves Recurse vs Final Return (research-the-web pattern).

nodes.name: Is generate_image?
nodes.notes: Route the pending custom tool. TRUE: name=generate_image -> Call Image Tool Handler. FALSE: an unregistered custom tool -> Build Error Result Text answers it with a 'tool not available' result (+ WARN) so the session never stalls on an unanswerable tool. v1 registers only generate_image; the FALSE branch is defensive.

nodes.name: Call Image Tool Handler
nodes.notes: ADR-053 Block 4: service the generate_image custom-tool call. Forwards tool_input_json (the agent's tool input), the session file_map_json (file_id->url for reference resolution), impact, a valid triggered_by (NOT image_gen — the handler defaults to image_gen only as a fallback; the per-image agent_runs rows need a valid enum), and passthrough metadata. Returns {status, file_ids[], images[]{file_id,b64_json,...}, message, warnings[], count_*}. The handler is fail-soft/branch-free and never throws into the session; onError=continueRegularOutput is a belt-and-braces guard. Its warnings are RETURNED here and fired once, consolidated, by Classify Alert -> Post Alert.

nodes.name: Build Result Text
nodes.notes: Serialize the Image Tool Handler result into the user.custom_tool_result text the agent reads (status + file_ids the agent embeds + the handler's human-readable message). Carries the produced images (file_id+b64) and the handler's warnings forward (new_images_json / new_warnings_json) for accumulation in Build Next State.

nodes.name: Build Error Result Text
nodes.notes: Defensive: an unregistered custom tool is answered with a 'not available' tool_result so the session resumes instead of stalling, plus a WARN. v1 only registers generate_image, so this is rarely reached.

nodes.name: Merge Result
nodes.notes: Converge the handler result text (input 0) and the unknown-tool error text (input 1) into ONE stream so Post Tool Result + Build Next State keep a single input. Exactly one branch executes per round.

nodes.name: Post Tool Result
nodes.notes: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/events user.custom_tool_result echoing the agent.custom_tool_use event's own id (Block 0) with the result text. retryOnFail so a transient post failure doesn't strand the tool (an unanswered tool is re-detected next poll; the 12-round cap bounds any waste). onError=continueRegularOutput so we still recurse and keep polling.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ events: [ { type: 'user.custom_tool_result', custom_tool_use_id: $('Poll Round').first().json.pending_tool_id, content: [ { type: 'text', text: $json.tool_result_text } ] } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Build Next State
nodes.notes: Accumulate produced images + warnings into the carried state, increment tool_round, and re-emit the full carried state for the Recurse self-call. deadline_epoch is preserved (absolute) so the soft-deadline spans all rounds. Contract-only inputs (user_message, input_images_json) are blanked — not needed after setup.

nodes.name: Recurse
nodes.notes: Recursive self-call for the next tool-servicing round (research-the-web mechanism). workflowId is THIS workflow (set post-create). LEAF: returns the child's eventual Final Return = the final result, propagated up the recursion. Depth bounded by the 12-round cap. session_id is set so the child takes the Is Recursive? TRUE path (skips setup).

nodes.name: Build Final Output
nodes.notes: Terminal (non-recursive) outcomes -> the Agent Session output contract: {status, output_message (final block-array text), files[] (produced image file_id+b64), file_ids[], usd_cost (NULL stub — Block 6 computes), session_usage + duration_seconds + web_search_count (raw cost surface for Block 6), model_used, session_id, warnings[]}. deadline/terminated/max_rounds/poll_error append their own WARN. Feeds Merge Final (input 0).

nodes.name: Merge Final
nodes.notes: Converge the normal terminal output (Build Final Output, 0), the create-failed output (1) and the send-failed output (2) into the ONE canonical output object. Final Return re-reads this node (research-the-web idiom) so the alert side-trip can't corrupt the return.

nodes.name: Classify Alert
nodes.notes: Decide a single consolidated alert from the output's warnings: failure_kind -> CRITICAL (session never started); any CRITICAL warning -> CRITICAL; else any warnings -> WARN; else no alert. Bundles all warnings (Upload Input Images + Image Tool Handler + poll/deadline/terminated) into one Post Alert call rather than spamming the channel.

nodes.name: Should Alert?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> Post Alert (one consolidated WARN/CRITICAL). FALSE -> straight to Merge Tail. Both rejoin at Merge Tail -> Final Return (single terminal).

nodes.name: Post Alert
nodes.notes: Centralized Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025) — never post to ClickUp directly. One call per session run. onError=continueRegularOutput so an alert-channel hiccup never breaks the session return. No loop risk: this workflow's trigger is executeWorkflow (orchestrator), not a webhook watching the Alerts task.

nodes.name: Merge Tail
nodes.notes: Rejoin the alerted (input 0) and not-alerted (input 1) paths into the single terminal input. Append; exactly one executes.

nodes.name: Final Return
nodes.notes: SOLE non-recursive TERMINAL. Re-reads the canonical output object from Merge Final (NOT its direct input, which Post Alert would have replaced) — the research-the-web return-determinism idiom. Returns the Agent Session contract object the caller (orchestrator / Block 6 output adapter) consumes.
